listing.name: Burnout (Xbox) (Burnout Recompilation)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream Windows launcher compiles from owned disc Limits: Version0.1.0 is explicitly early and incomplete; local compilation route exists. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 x86-64 source/setup package; local Xbox game compilation. Early incomplete release. Original data: Own Burnout USA original Xbox disc as ISO. Upstream launcher extracts the data and compiles the game on the player computer. This is the 2001/2002 original Burnout Xbox edition, not Burnout 2/3; exact executable revision/hash is not specified in reviewed README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
